title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28 (UK Master's)
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
benefits: Full tuition, return airfare to the UK, and a monthly living allowance (£1,712, or £2,000 in London) for a one-year Master's.
eligibility: Ghanaian citizen living in Ghana; at least an upper second-class (2:1) degree; cannot afford UK study without this award; no year or more of study or work in a high-income country. Master's only.
howTo: Apply on CSC Central (closes 16:00 GMT, 8 Dec 2026) AND apply for admission to an approved course at a participating UK university.

title: GETFund Local Tertiary Scholarship 2026/27
benefits: Financial support (tuition) for Ghanaian students in accredited tertiary institutions in Ghana, undergraduate and postgraduate.
eligibility: Ghanaian citizen admitted to, or already enrolled in, an accredited tertiary institution in Ghana.
howTo: Apply online only at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh before Friday 27 Nov 2026. Never pay anyone to apply.
via: GETFund portal, dates from Pulse Ghana and YEN

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Cambridge (Oct 2027 entry)
benefits: Fully funded one-year Master's at Cambridge for young Africans; application fee waiver available.
eligibility: African citizen normally resident in Africa; bachelor's degree meeting your course's entry requirements; full-time Master's only (not PhD or undergraduate).
howTo: Apply through the Cambridge course application and opt in for funding. The deadline is your course's funding deadline: early December or early January. 8 Dec is the earliest date reported, so check your course page.
via: Cambridge official page (exact date varies by course)

title: UNFPA Ghana Internship (Global Internship Roster 2026)
benefits: Hands-on experience at a UN agency in Ghana for students and new graduates, including young persons with disabilities.
eligibility: Enrolled in a first degree (one full academic year completed) or a postgraduate programme, or a recent graduate who starts within one year of graduating.
howTo: Apply through the UNFPA jobs page before 31 Dec 2026, 23:59 (New York time). UNFPA never charges application fees.
